questions.applicability_evidence: This item applies to every dataset.

passed: The NIH funder is accompanied by grant details, and the stated purposes align with the described funding goals.
The reported project start date precedes the project end date.
The earlier lower bound of over 45,000 admissions is compatible with the stated current count of 50,000.
The anticipated counts of admissions and critically ill patients are explicitly distinguished as different units.
The 1,000-image report and 7,642-admission radiology report are explicitly distinguished as different units.
The public-availability goal and controlled training-program access are described with distinct scope; the GitHub MIT license is not transferred to dataset reuse.
EEG extraction, broader imaging de-identification, labeling, and holdout provisioning are identified as work in progress or plans rather than uniformly completed capabilities.
warnings: Ethical review and consent or waiver coverage cannot be checked against the privacy narrative because those declarations are absent.
Substantive dataset license terms are unavailable, preventing verification of reuse permissions against the described access requirements.
The source-preserved program-manager email domain remains unverified.

issues_detected.description: Five of fourteen specified completeness fields are unpopulated, including variable metadata, DOI, structural relationships, and confidentiality classification.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document variables, confidentiality, a durable dataset identifier, and any actual dataset relationships without inventing relationships that do not exist.

issues_detected.description: The distribution entry identifies an enclave rather than an enumerated file distribution. Only DICOM and WFDB clearly establish available file types; prospective EEG formats do not establish released files.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide a release-specific inventory with file formats, media types, counts, and availability status for each modality.

issues_detected.description: Planned privacy transformations and imaging de-identification in progress do not establish basic ethics oversight, consent or waiver coverage, or implemented safeguards.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document applicable ethics reviews, consent or waiver arrangements, implemented privacy methods, residual risks, and protections for pediatric or other vulnerable participants.

issues_detected.description: Registration and agreement requirements are documented, but confidentiality classification, applicable regulatory obligations, intellectual-property restrictions, and accountable governance arrangements are not.
issues_detected.recommendation: Publish the applicable governance requirements, confidentiality classification, responsible governance contact, and relevant compliance basis.

issues_detected.description: Named standards and general mapping descriptions do not supply a release-specific schema and actionable cross-platform integration procedure.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide schema and vocabulary versions, mapping references, linking identifiers, and procedures for integrating modalities and site contributions.

issues_detected.description: Processing strategies and OHNLP are identified, but software versions, direct tool references, workflow parameters, annotation-quality methods, and missing-data handling are not documented.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document reproducible processing versions and workflows, with annotation-quality and missing-data procedures or explicit statements of their status.

issues_detected.description: Retrospective collection and raw systems are described without clinical collection windows, designated collectors, or a complete acquisition protocol.
issues_detected.recommendation: Specify the contributing sites and responsible collection roles, clinical date ranges, and modality-specific acquisition procedures.

issues_detected.description: Current-versus-target growth information does not identify a dataset version, maintained release history, responsible maintainer, or preservation commitment.
issues_detected.recommendation: Assign release identifiers and dates, provide version access and change history, and document maintenance responsibility and a durable preservation route.

issues_detected.description: External source references are identifiable in narrative text, but a formal citation for the dataset is absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide a recommended dataset citation identifying its title and authors or publishing organization, together with stable links to associated resources.

issues_detected.description: Admission totals and care settings do not describe realized demographic distributions, subgroup coverage, or operational inclusion and exclusion criteria.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document cohort eligibility, demographic and clinical subgroup distributions, site coverage, and missingness in representation metadata.

issues_detected.description: The training-program access tier is described, but a registration endpoint, enclave login route, and complete access path for general researchers are absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide the current access-request or registration URL, enclave platform and login instructions, and eligibility and authorization requirements for each user group.

issues_detected.description: The required agreement is mentioned without substantive dataset reuse rights. Explicit permitted, prohibited, and discouraged uses and social-impact mitigation are not documented.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide the dataset agreement or an authoritative summary of reuse terms, permitted and restricted uses, foreseeable impacts, and mitigation measures.

issues_detected.description: Source-system and processing descriptions are not connected into complete entity-activity-agent lineage for a particular release; realized split and missing-data documentation are also absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Link source extracts, processing activities, responsible agents, and released outputs in structured text or a provenance graph, and document realized splits and quality limitations.

issues_detected.description: Diversity and balanced-cohort goals are not accompanied by identification of known biases, scope-related effects on use, or fairness analysis.
issues_detected.recommendation: Identify selection, measurement, site, temporal, and subgroup biases where supported, explain their implications for intended uses, and document fairness evaluations and mitigation.

issues_detected.description: The program-manager email uses the unusual domain mgh.havard.edu. The record explicitly preserves the source spelling, so this is an unresolved source-level contact concern rather than a demonstrated transcription error.
issues_detected.recommendation: Confirm the contact address with an authoritative current source before relying on it.

semantic_insights: Current release quantities, dated historical reports, and future targets are explicitly distinguished.
Admissions and patients, and images and admissions with radiology, are treated as different measurement units rather than forced into false numerical comparisons.
The GitHub project's MIT license is correctly not asserted as the dataset license.
Funding and creator attribution are detailed and internally coherent.
OHNLP tokenization, OMOP standardization, and modality-specific source systems provide useful technical context despite incomplete reproducibility and lineage.
All scoring covers the complete submitted record at #; nested evidence retains its actual path and receives no separate unit score.
